description: This script sets up an in-memory SQLite database with a virtual table using the 'vec0' extension for vector similarity search. It defines functions to load the extension, creates a virtual table for embeddings, inserts sample data, performs a cosine distance query, and outputs the results. The file manages loading the extension and handles errors related to extension loading.

methods.name: vec
methods.description: Converts an array of values into a Buffer containing a Float32Array, suitable for database insertion as a vector.
